messages:
Ivy M: Heads-up: small IA change proposal for the console nav. Idea: group sidebar into three top-level zones (Overview / Model Registry / Admin) and collapse less-used items into a secondary drawer. Goal: fewer clicks, better deep-link UX. Draft: https://figma.com/s/console-compact-ia

Leo G: For deep links we should prefer path segments: `/p/:project/zone/registry/...`. Keeps links stable and search-indexable.

Priya S: Agree on path. Also propose breadcrumb rules: always show `Projects / <Project Name> / <Zone> / <Page>`; shorten zone label to one word in compact crumbs.

Rafael T: Accessibility notes: on deep-link we need to focus the main headline, add `aria-current` to the active nav item, and ensure keyboard users can open zone accordion with space/enter.

access-bot: Reminder: add `role=\"navigation\" aria-label=\"Primary navigation\"` and a visible skip link to `#main`.

QA-Rob: Tests to add: load deep-link to `/zone/registry/models`, back/forward after normalization, and keyboard-only navigation through grouped items. Watch for scroll-jump on anchor loads.

Ivy M: Implementation idea: normalize legacy `#zone=` and `?zone=` links to canonical path on first load using `history.replaceState`. Emit event `nav.normalized` when we rewrite.

Leo G: Also, keep collapse state out of canonical links (sessionStorage). If product insists, expose collapse via fragment only as optional.

Priya S: Copy tweak: left nav full label 'Model Registry' -> compact 'Registry'; breadcrumb compact = 'Registry'. Root crumb = 'Projects' not 'Workspace'.

Rafael T: Minor: use 3px focus ring and visible focus color per design tokens. Add sr-only hint when collapsed: \", current\" for screen readers.

Ivy M: Action items: I will update Figma and provide final copy. Leo to draft route spec + normalization behavior. Rafael to add a11y checklist. QA-Rob to add e2e cases. We'll reconvene after mock updates. Thanks!
